mapper.select: SELECT transmission_date AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN amount WHEN status = 'CANCELED' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) AS amount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 WHEN status = 'CANCELED' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS successAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS cancelAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelCount FROM payment WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS', 'CANCELED') AND transmission_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY), '%Y%m%d') GROUP BY transmission_date ORDER BY transmission_date ASC

SELECT settlement_month AS month, SUM(settlement_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM settlement WHERE status != 'DELETED' AND settlement_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH), '%Y-%m') GROUP BY settlement_month ORDER BY settlement_month ASC
